description: This file declares functions and constants related to git annotated commits in the libgit2 library, including creation, lookup, and freeing of annotated commit objects.

methods.name: git_annotated_commit_from_ref
methods.description: Creates a git_annotated_commit from a reference in a repository.

methods.name: git_annotated_commit_from_fetchhead
methods.description: Creates a git_annotated_commit from fetch head data.

methods.name: git_annotated_commit_lookup
methods.description: Creates a git_annotated_commit from a commit id.

methods.name: git_annotated_commit_from_revspec
methods.description: Creates a git_annotated_commit from a revision string.

methods.name: git_annotated_commit_id
methods.description: Retrieves the commit ID that the annotated commit refers to.
